findings.title: Migrate callers before removing the findMany API
findings.body: This replaces the public `findMany(args)` method with `getBaseConditions()`, but the PR only migrates the integration test and includes no production caller updates or compatibility method. Existing callers of `InsightsBookingService.findMany` will fail TypeScript compilation (or throw `findMany is not a function` at runtime). Keep a compatible query method or migrate all consumers to execute raw queries with the new conditions in the same change.
